rationales.defaultCode: Renamed from 'default_code'; contents unchanged, so same mapping. Variant-level style codes (TSH-1001), unique per row. R4.2.
rationales.categId: Renamed from 'categ_id'; contents unchanged, so same mapping. Constant category path (All / Apparel / Knit). Same judgement as item_group in schema B, must stay consistent with it.
rationales.barcode: 13-digit barcode values, one per variant. R3.4 / R4.1. The check digits are not valid, so the data is synthetic; the mapping rests on meaning, not validity.
rationales.uom_id: Holds Units, a unit of measure. R3.2 / R2.2.
rationales.weight: Decimal weights (0.180), same values as ERPNext weight_per_unit. R3.4. Odoo exports weight in kg by default.
rationales.volume: Decimal volume (0.0012), no CDM volume field. R2.2.
rationales.standard_price: Cost price. R3.4 / R2.2: reads clearly, maps to nothing.
rationales.descript: Renamed from 'description_sale'; contents unchanged, so same mapping. Sales marketing copy. R3.3.
rationales.type: Odoo product type flag (product). R2.2: workflow field.
rationales.x_studio_coo: LK; the R3.4 example for this exact header.
rationales.x_stud: Renamed from 'x_studio_lot'; contents unchanged, so same mapping. DL-7781 is an actual batch value, not a flag. R3.1 contrast case.
rationales.x_studio_vendor_gln: 13-digit GLN of the vendor. R4.3, same call as supplier_gln in schema B.
